summary: Frontend-only verification of Wayly greeting + mobile trial banner + Plan & Billing polish + shadow* console cleanup. Web and mobile dashboard greetings work (Good morning/afternoon/evening + first name, testID dashboard-greeting). Mobile trial banner logic is correct: absent for non-trial cathy@example.com; present as amber strip on dashboard AND on other tabs (statements) once a fresh account starts a trial; tap routes to /plan-billing. Plan & Billing trial countdown (billing-trial-countdown = '7 days left in your free trial ... Ends 23 August 2026...') and billing-add-card ('Add a card now') render correctly, and billing-portal is still present. Zero 'shadow*' RN-web deprecation warnings observed on dashboard, statements, or plan-billing screens. ONE HIGH-PRIORITY BUG: tapping billing-add-card (and billing-portal) on mobile hits /api/portal which returns 404 — the correct backend endpoint is /api/payments/portal. This blocks the 'one-tap Add a card now' Stripe portal flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Add a card now' (testID billing-add-card) and 'Manage card & billing' (testID billing-portal) calls apiFetch('/portal', ...) which resolves to GET/POST /api/portal → 404 Not Found. Screen shows red 'Not Found' error under the trial countdown. The actual Stripe portal endpoint is /api/payments/portal. Fix in /app/mobile/app/plan-billing.tsx:71 by changing apiFetch<>('/portal', ...) to apiFetch<>('/payments/portal', ...).

integration_issues.flow: Stripe billing portal (Add a card now / Manage card & billing)
integration_issues.issue: /api/portal → 404. Should call /api/payments/portal. Confirmed via network log: '404 https://statement-checker-3.preview.emergentagent.com/api/portal'.

parity_issues.issue: Web opens Stripe portal successfully; mobile fails with 404 because mobile calls /api/portal instead of /api/payments/portal.
parity_issues.expected: Tapping 'Add a card now' opens external Stripe portal in expo-web-browser.
parity_issues.actual: Mobile shows 'Not Found' error message under the trial countdown.

action_items: Change /app/mobile/app/plan-billing.tsx line 71 from apiFetch<{...}>('/portal', ...) to apiFetch<{...}>('/payments/portal', ...) so 'Add a card now' and 'Manage card & billing' both hit the working backend endpoint. (Confirmed via curl: /api/payments/portal returns a valid response; /api/portal returns 404.)
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile portal call path drifts from backend route: TrialBanner and PlanBillingScreen depend on the same /portal path — a shared constant (e.g. BILLING_PORTAL_PATH = '/payments/portal') would prevent future drift.

TrialBanner cache TTL is 45s (good), but starting a trial in /plan-select correctly calls invalidateTrialCache() — verified: banner appeared on dashboard within one navigation cycle after start-trial.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Greeting (web + mobile) and trial banner (mobile) are fully working. Only remaining issue is the /portal → /payments/portal path in /app/mobile/app/plan-billing.tsx (line 71). Same file also uses openPortal for the 'Manage card & billing' outline button so both testIDs (billing-add-card, billing-portal) will be fixed by the single path change. After E1 fixes, retest by logging in as the trial user above and tapping billing-add-card — should open Stripe portal in expo-web-browser (external) instead of showing 'Not Found'.
rca of the issue: In /app/mobile/app/plan-billing.tsx openPortal() calls apiFetch<>('/portal', ...) which becomes ${EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/portal. The backend only exposes the Stripe billing portal at /api/payments/portal (confirmed in /app/backend/routes/payments.py line 211). Result: 404 Not Found, surfaced in the UI as a red 'Not Found' line. Reproduction: login as trialing user → /plan-billing → tap 'Add a card now'. Mitigation: change the path string to '/payments/portal'.
